name: vibestore
description: VibeStore - Advanced admin dashboard with real-time statistics, newsletter management, and user reports system (No Cloud Functions - 100% Free Tier)

scripts.firebase:serve: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore,auth
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && npx firebase deploy
